events.title: Treaty of Friendship and British protection
hints: A Pacific kingdom gave up control of its foreign relations in 1900.
A British consul had authority over foreigners.
Full sovereignty was regained in June 1970.
events.summary: Tonga, which kept its monarchy throughout the colonial era, signed a Treaty of Friendship and Protection with Britain in 1900, giving Britain control over its foreign relations and a consul with authority over foreigners. The treaty was ended in 1970 when Tonga became fully independent.
